root_cause_and_correction.inertia: MuJoCo compiler-side diagonalization of fullinertia lost approximately 2.17e-9 kg*m^2 for the nearly repeated principal inertias of link2 and link3. The correction keeps the threshold unchanged and deterministically pre-diagonalizes each URDF body tensor with pinned NumPy eigh, emitting diaginertia plus a canonical right-handed quaternion. An in-memory probe reduced the full mass-matrix maximum difference from 2.4889065183830716e-9 to 3.552713678800501e-15.
root_cause_and_correction.negative_control: NC08 accidentally mutated the default geom rather than a named worldbody geom. The correction selects a named emitted geom; the production model remains contact-disabled and unchanged in authority.
